title: GTA6 Faces First Plagiarism Accusation Over Custom SMG Decal
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 faces its first plagiarism accusation after fans compared a custom SMG decal from a furry rescue encounter with a 2021 illustration by GabyT.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Faces First Plagiarism Accusation Over Custom SMG Decal

As anticipation for *Grand Theft Auto 6* continues to reach unprecedented heights, the upcoming open-world epic has found itself at the center of its very first controversy. According to a report by gaming media outlet GameRant, the game has been hit with its first-ever plagiarism accusation, revolving around a custom weapon asset spotted within the game.

### The Source of the Controversy

The issue stems from a custom submachine gun (SMG) featured during one of *GTA 6*'s furry rescue encounters. Rockstar Games has long been celebrated for its intricate detail, satirical takes on modern culture, and deeply customizable weapon and vehicle assets. However, the weapon in question has caught the attention of fans not for its satirical value, but for its visual origins.

According to fan comparisons, the decal printed on the custom SMG bears striking similarities to a piece of artwork created back in 2021 by illustrator GabyT. After eagle-eyed fans placed the game asset side-by-side with the 2021 illustration, tracing and unauthorized asset use accusations quickly began to circulate within online communities.

### Broader Context and Industry Implications

At this stage, the situation remains an online observation and media-reported controversy, as Rockstar Games has not issued any official statements regarding the comparison. In the vast and complex landscape of AAA game development, large teams frequently utilize concept artists, external contractors, or reference imagery, which occasionally leads to oversight in asset verification.

Industry analysis suggests that while this specific incident involves a minor detail—a weapon decal rather than a core gameplay mechanic—the immense spotlight on *GTA 6* means that every single frame and texture will be scrutinized by millions of players. How the developer chooses to address this potential oversight, whether through a silent texture update or an official statement, remains to be seen.

## Editor's Take

While this first plagiarism accusation against *GTA 6* involves a relatively minor asset like a gun decal, it highlights the immense pressure and scrutiny surrounding Rockstar's upcoming title. Even if it turns out to be an innocent reference or an oversight by a third-party asset creator, it serves as a reminder that transparency and rigorous asset auditing are more crucial than ever for modern AAA blockbusters.
